Agent brand icons

The image files live in src/studio/assets/agent-brands/ and identify the
Agent tools and model sources that ShowAI can connect to.

codex.svg, claude-code.svg, gemini-cli.svg, opencode.svg, openai.svg,
openrouter.svg and deepseek.svg are from LobeHub Icons:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
They are distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE.lobe-icons.txt.

kimi.png is the official Kimi logo. See NOTICE.kimi-logo.txt for its source.
The same artwork identifies Moonshot model sources.

Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners.
